maya.r: Hi folks — day 2 here. I accepted the org invite but can't push to infra/terraform. I get a 403 on git push and the repo UI shows "Not Found". I did SSO and 2FA. Anyone seen this?

ops-it: Welcome @maya.r! Can you confirm the email on your GitHub account and whether you accepted the invite by clicking the link in the invite email? Sometimes users accept with a different personal account which ends up as an outside collaborator. :wave:

maya.r: account email is maya.recruit+redwood@gmail.com — I clicked the link sent to that address. In org -> people my entry is listed but the role column says "Outside collaborator".

chris.dev: If you're an outside collaborator you won't have team-based repo access. Two things to try: 1) check whether your GitHub profile has any other verified emails (Settings -> Emails). 2) run `gh api user` and `gh api orgs/redwood-inference/memberships/$(gh api user | jq -r .login)` to see membership state.

maya.r: Output of `gh api user | jq -r .login`: "maya-r". The membership api call returns 404.

ops-it: OK that confirms the account isn't an org member. Likely the invite was misrouted or you were added as an external collaborator on a repo instead of invited to the org. @elaine.hr can you check the onboarding invite record?

elaine.hr: Checking now. HR invited via the org invite flow using the work email on the offer. Looks like the invite was sent to maya.recruit@personal-alias.com due to how the offer form populated the contact. It auto-accepted when you clicked, which created a link to your personal account. We'll need to remove the external collaborator entry and resubmit a proper org invite to maya.recruit+redwood@gmail.com.

maya.r: Ack, thanks. If you re-invite do I need to do anything special (I have YubiKey + Authenticator set up already)?

ops-it: No special steps. Once admin re-sends the invite to the correct email, accept it while logged into the correct GH account (maya-r). If you see a browser prompt to switch accounts, choose the work-mapped account. After acceptance SAML provisioning should add you to teams automatically.

chris.dev: After that, confirm with `gh repo view redwood-inference/infra/terraform` and `gh api orgs/redwood-inference/teams --jq '.[] | select(.name=="infra")'` (or just check Teams in the org UI). If you still get 404, logout and clear cookies to avoid stale session.

onboard-bot: Ticket #4289 created: "new-hire github invite routed to personal alias" assigned to infra-admins. ETA: 4 business hours.

maya.r: One more Q — I accepted the invite once already. Should I remove myself from the org first or just accept the new invite?

ops-it: Don't try to self-remove. Wait for admins to remove the external collaborator record then accept the fresh invite. If you remove yourself it can complicate SSO mapping.

elaine.hr: Filed the admin request to remove external collaborator and resend invite to maya.recruit+redwood@gmail.com. CC'ing infra-admins.

maya.r: Thanks all — appreciate the quick help. I'll ping when I can see the repo. :thanks:
